prompt:
Create an original horizontal full-body group illustration of FOUR adult dwarves of the Blue Mountains for The One Ring culture art collection. Match recent horizontal culture illustrations: fine expressive warm muted brown pencil and pen contours, moderate selective directional hatching and limited crosshatching, small rich umber recesses, broad pale ivory paper highlights. Traditional slightly stylized fantasy book drawing, not cinematic painting or dense photorealistic texture.
Four distinct compact broad strong dwarves, two men and two women, a companionable group of craftspeople and travelers, with standing and seated mix. Left a standing mature dwarf woman with thick braided hair tucked under a practical cloth cap, expressive wide face, sturdy long tunic, wool shawl and work apron, holding a small plain wooden tool box naturally at waist. Center-left a standing older dwarf man with long forked braided beard and swept-back hair, heavy belted tunic with restrained angular trim, worn travel cloak, small belt pouches, one hand resting on a grounded walking staff and a sheathed short sword at hip. Center-right foreground a seated adult dwarf craftswoman with a strong angular face, hair in thick side braids, rolled sleeves, protective leather apron over plain tunic and trousers, resting a modest smith's hammer across her knees while seated on a low plain wooden stool. Right a standing younger male dwarf traveler with a thick shorter beard, practical soft hood worn down, leather shoulder protection over quilted tunic, rolled blanket and small pack, holding a sturdy axe safely down at his side. Distinct expressive faces, natural large hands, broad torsos, short thick limbs and heavy ordinary boots. No royal crowns or elaborate plate armor.
Clothing and tools convey skilled everyday craftsmanship, economical geometric stitched borders, no readable runes. Beard and hair drawn as grouped locks with paper gaps rather than individual hairs, cloth folds shaded selectively, apron with a few wear lines. Approximately 16:10 landscape composition, all four full figures comfortably spread across frame, heads, boots, staff, stool and tools wholly inside generous pale margins. Nearly white ivory paper background, faint sketch hatch marks immediately behind shoulders and small ground strokes beneath feet fade into blank. No mountain scenery, lettering, border, watermark, full color, gray graphite wash, smooth blended photographic shading or thick cartoon outlines. Four adult dwarves only.
